result.summary: All 4 PLC test files (plc01..plc04, 27 tests) now compile after fixing plc04_visibility_test.zig:373 (pool.acquire() returns PoolError, not optional). All 27 tests still fail at the migration harness step (runMigrationsForSchema → MigrationFailed on tenant_default) due to a pre-existing scope-header casing bug in migrations/1157_prm09_solution_pack_update.sql (`-- Scope: public.` is case-sensitive in src/db/migrations.zig::migrationScope, so the public-scoped migration is misclassified as all_schemas and applied to tenant_default where it cannot find column tenant_id). TEST-RUNNER scope is limited to compile-error-class fixes; the migration header bug requires ISSUE-FIXER.

issues.description: F-PLC-COMPILE-plc04_visibility_test.zig:373 — RESOLVED IN-REWORK. Compile error fixed by replacing pool.acquire().?.query(...) pattern with var conn = try pool.acquire(); defer pool.release(conn); const rows = try conn.query(...).

F-PLC-MIGRATION-1157-scope-header — OPEN, NEEDS ISSUE-FIXER. migrations/1157_prm09_solution_pack_update.sql line 5 reads `-- Scope: public.` (capital S); src/db/migrations.zig::migrationScope matches `-- scope: public` case-sensitively, so the public-scoped migration is silently classified as all_schemas and applied to tenant_default. ALTER TABLE solution_pack_installs ADD COLUMN tenant_id fails because tenant_default's solution_pack_installs (created by 1158) has no tenant_id column. Same casing bug exists in migrations/1156_prm06_promotion_assertion_runs.sql (`-- Scope: tenant_only.`). Fix: lowercase the S in both files' scope header (line 5 / line 6). Introduced in commit 47d4c7c9.

result.next_action: ISSUE-FIXER — file and resolve the scope-header casing bug in migrations/1157 + 1156 (lowercase the S), then redispatch TEST-RUNNER.
